title: “How can we learn and use AI at the same time?”: Participatory Design of GenAI with High School Students

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of high school students' workshop discussions regarding how inherent human biases, geographic backgrounds, and personal beliefs are reflected in AI training data.
Qualitative thematic analysis of student discussions identifying concerns that AI text detectors disproportionately and unfairly flag the writing of international students.
